tagline: Self-hosted anime and manga media server (default root image)
description:
Seanime is an open-source media server with a web interface and desktop
app for anime and manga. It integrates with AniList, manages your local
library, streams and downloads episodes, and plays them with your media
player of choice.

This package uses the default image (umagistr/seanime), which runs as
root. There is no UID/GID to match, so it can read and write any media
folder, at the cost of running with more privileges than the rootless
variant. It uses host port 3212 so it can run next to the other
Seanime variants.
author: restuindrawan

tips.before_install:
Default image: Seanime runs as root inside the container, so any
media ownership works. Files
Seanime creates in the downloads folder will be owned by root. If
you want a non-root process instead, install Seanime Rootless.

This app has its own config folder and WebUI port (3212), so it
does not share settings with the other Seanime variants. Do not run
two variants against the same downloads folder at the same time.

Publishing outside your LAN: set a server password first. Seanime's
docs require server.password when the server is reachable from
outside this machine. Set SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD during install,
or edit config.toml in the config folder after the first start and
set password under [server], then restart. A password is not
encryption: prefer a VPN such as Tailscale or an HTTPS reverse
proxy over forwarding plain HTTP port 3212 on your router.

title: Seanime
release_note: Add the default (root) Seanime variant, pinned to v3.10.4, on host port 3212 with optional SEANIME_SERVER_PASSWORD.
